description: Intense visible absorption band at 665 nm (thiazine monomer) with a shoulder at ~610 nm (H-dimer), arising from extended π-conjugation through the phenothiazinium ring system.
transition: π → π* (S₀ → S₁) extended conjugation across the thiazine scaffold
clinicalNote: Used as a redox indicator (blue when oxidised, colourless when reduced) and as a model dye in adsorption/photocatalysis studies; clinically employed as a sentinel node dye and antidote for methaemoglobinaemia.

sources.purpose: Chemical identity and molecular weight (CID 6099, MW 319.9 g/mol)
λmax 665 nm (monomer) and 605/610 nm (dimer) confirmed in aqueous solution; molar extinction coefficient basis from spectroscopic analysis of monomer-dimer equilibria
